mechanism_narrative: When monthly consumer demand proxies (HOUST) exceed 600, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are positive due to expectations of stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-positive when demand crosses 600 from below, or IC < 0.05 over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL inflation index triggers a 5-day S&P 500 bearish move as investors anticipate rate hikes before the FOMC meeting.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative when inflation does not cross 215, or IC > 0.2 over 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4% (UNRATE < 4), the S&P 500 expects higher corporate profits and posts positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are flat or negative when UNRATE >= 4, or IC < 0.1 over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in industrial production (INDPRO > 96) coincides with S&P 500 20-day up-moves as supply-side expansion supports demand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive when INDPRO is above 96 in <30% of months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising retail employment (PAYEMS > 135k) create a momentum effect that drives S&P 500 60-day forward returns positively.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day returns flat when momentum does not materialize after two consecutive months of gains.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows negative 20-day forward returns as deflationary expectations rise.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS <= 4% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE - 0.5pp in one month) predicts a 5-day S&P 500 rally as market anticipates wage growth.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by >0.5pp in a single month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when UNRATE decline is not sharp or not followed by rally.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer confidence (HOUST > 600) in the same month predicts S&P 500 20-day gains as dual expansion signals resilience.
failure_condition: 20-day returns flat when both proxies are simultaneously high but not correlated, or IC < 0.05 over 6 months.
